title: Wear app: Watch face settings menu (double-tab, settings) crashes Watch face when scrolling to the end.
symptom: Watch face settings menu (double-tab, settings) crashes when scrolling down to the end. After this sometime the watchface switches to 'black' and can only be restored by restarting the watch.
cause: The issue was fixed by a commit, but the root cause is not explicitly described in the thread.
fix: Fixed by commit be199719bd92ac85a6d32587a839f3f728591f20. Users affected need to uninstall and reinstall the wear app.
evidence_quote: fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/be199719bd92ac85a6d32587a839f3f728591f20 you need to uninstall/install if you are affected by this bug
